name: connect-apps
description: Just-in-time app connections: answers from Station connectors, posts one Connect card when an app is missing (private to the owner, under their message, in a room with other people), and resumes the owner's request after sign-in through a detached waiter and one resume task. The precheck hook tells the agent, on its first touch of a task, which apps the message names and (from the 30s read cache) which are not connected.
